description.value: Toad River Lodge is a family-owned full-service complex on Reflection Lake at Mile 422 of the Alaska Highway, offering motel rooms, lakeside cabins with kitchenettes, and a 23-site RV park — all open year-round. The lodge is famous for its ceiling-mounted hat collection of over 7,200 hats from around the world, and includes an on-site restaurant, laundromat, Canada Post outlet, and a service garage with tire repair, gas, diesel, and propane. For cycle tourists riding remote northern BC, it is one of the few full-service stops in a very long stretch of highway.
